concerns.text: The plan relies on a deterministic synthetic data generator as the primary analysis source (see “synthetic data generator” paragraph). While this satisfies pipeline verification, it cannot answer the core research question—how surface‑treatment parameters *associate* with real polymer adhesion strength—because the synthetic data do not reflect true material behavior. Consequently, the proposed methodology will not provide valid evidence for SC‑001 or SC‑002 on real data, violating construct validity and rendering the scientific claims unsound.
